description: This file defines a React component for the index route of a notes application. It sets up a layout with a navbar, sidebar, main content area, and a floating action button to add new notes. It manages redirection from the root path and includes UI components like Outlet for nested routes and a stub for sidebar tags.

methods.name: IndexLayout
methods.description: Main layout component for the notes app's index route, managing navigation and layout structure.

methods.name: FloatingActionButton
methods.description: Component rendering a floating button to trigger adding a new note.

methods.name: SidebarTags
methods.description: Component rendering a list of sidebar tags, currently stubbed with hardcoded tags.
